claim.claim-text: 1. A position sensor device (501; 601; 701; 801; 901; 1001; 1101) for determining a position relative to a magnetic field source that generates a magnetic field and for determining a fault, the position sensor device comprising:

- at least three magnetic sensitive elements (1311; 1312; 1313) for measuring at least three magnetic field values of said magnetic field; and - a processing circuit (1320) configured for obtaining said at least three magnetic field values, and for determining at least two magnetic field gradients or at least two magnetic field differences based on said at least three magnetic field values, and for deriving from said at least two magnetic field gradients or from said at least two magnetic field differences a first signal (POS) indicative of a position of the magnetic source relative to the position sensor device;characterised in that- the processing circuit (1320) is further configured for providing a second signal (signal2; signal2'; INT) indicative of a fault;

- the second signal is derived from said at least two magnetic field gradients or from said at least two magnetic field differences; - the position sensor device is further configured for outputting this second signal (signal2; signal2'; INT).
2. A position sensor device according to claim 1,

comprising at least four sensitive elements for measuring at least four magnetic field values; wherein the processing circuit is configured for determining a first magnetic field gradient based on two of said at least four magnetic field values, and for determining a second magnetic field gradient based on two other of said at least four magnetic field values.
3. A position sensor device according to any of the previous claims,

4. A position sensor device according to any of the previous claims, wherein the sensor device is further configured for comparing the second signal with at least one threshold value (T1), and for providing an output signal corresponding to an outcome of the at least one comparison.
5. A position sensor device (501; 601; 701; 801; 901; 1001) according to any of the previous claims,
wherein the sensor device comprises four magnetic sensitive elements; and wherein the sensor device is configured for determining an angular position.
6. A position sensor device (501; 701; 901) according to claim 5,

wherein the sensor device comprises a semiconductor substrate; and wherein the sensor device is configured for measuring two first magnetic field components (Bx1, Bx2) oriented in a first direction (X) parallel to the semiconductor substrate, at two sensor locations (X1, X2) spaced apart in the first direction (X); and for determining a first magnetic field gradient (dBx/dx) of these first magnetic field components along the first direction (X); and wherein the sensor device is configured for measuring two second magnetic field components (By1, By2) oriented in a second direction (Y) parallel to the semiconductor substrate and perpendicular to the first direction (X) at said two sensor locations (X1, X2); and for determining a second magnetic field gradient (dBy/dx) of these second magnetic field components along the first direction; and wherein the sensor device is further configured for calculating the second signal as a function of this first and second magnetic field gradient.
7. A position sensor device (601; 801; 1001) according to claim 5,

wherein the sensor device comprises a semiconductor substrate; and wherein the sensor device is configured for measuring two first magnetic field components (Bx1, Bx2) oriented in a first direction (X) parallel to the semiconductor substrate, at two sensor locations (X1, X2) spaced apart in the first direction (X); and for determining a first magnetic field gradient (dBx/dx) of these first magnetic field components along the first direction (X); and wherein the sensor device is configured for measuring two second magnetic field components (Bz1, Bz2) oriented in a direction (Z) perpendicular to the semiconductor substrate at said two sensor locations (X1, X2); and for determining a second magnetic field gradient (dBz/dx) of these second magnetic field components along the first direction (X); and wherein the sensor device is further configured for calculating the second signal as a function of this first and second magnetic field gradient.
8. A position sensor device (1101) according to any of the claims 1 to 4,

9. A magnetic sensor device according to any of the previous claims, wherein the magnetic sensitive elements comprise two magnetic sensors, each comprising: two horizontal Hall elements arranged near a periphery of an integrated magnetic concentrator, or a horizontal Hall element and a vertical Hall element, or four horizontal Hall elements arranged near a periphery of an integrated magnetic concentrator, or two vertical Hall elements oriented perpendicular to each other, or a horizontal Hall element and a vertical Hall element.
10. A magnetic position sensor system comprising:
- said magnetic field source; - a magnetic sensor device according to any of the previous claims, movably mounted relative to the magnetic field source.
11. Method (1200) of determining a position relative to a magnetic field source that generates a magnetic field and of determining a fault, the method comprising the steps of:

12. Method according to claim 11, further comprising the step of comparing the second signal with at least one threshold value (T1); and wherein step e) comprises: providing an output signal corresponding to an outcome of the at least one comparison.
